decisions.summary: Use reviewed case assessments only while the cited facts and provisions match.
decisions.concern: Changed records could invalidate a previously supported assessment.
options: Reuse prior outcomes by system ID
Verify the basis and defer changed cases for review
decisions.chosen_behavior: Verify the basis and mark affected assessments unresolved when it changes.
decisions.rationale: A stable system identity does not establish that the use, evidence or legal text remains the same.
tradeoffs: A material change requires review before a supported assessment can be restored.
decisions.downstream_effect: Later stages carry the unresolved item without inventing an approval or action date.
